items.document_title: Low Temperature Cooling Chamber for DWTT Impact Specimens QualiLTC80 DWTT (Qualitest product page)
items.note: The Qualitest technical specification gives only approximate cooling RATES per temperature band (about 1.3/1.3/1.0/0.8 C per min from room temperature down to -80 C); no pull-down TIME to the set point is printed. Deriving a time from these 'about' rates would be an estimate, so no value is recorded. No other source found.

items.quote: allows samples to be cooled from room temperature to a stable 1.8 K in less than 30 minutes.
items.document_title: MPMS 3 Platform Measurement Options (Quantum Design brochure 1500-103 Rev. E1)
items.note: Sample cooldown from room temperature to the 1.8 K base in the (already cold, LHe-filled) standard dewar; the spec table also gives 300 K to 10 K in 15 min + 10 K to 1.8 K in 5 min (typical). The initial warm-dewar cooldown of the standard LHe (non-EverCool) system (LN2 precool + LHe transfer) is not documented; the ~30 h / <50 h figures in QD documents apply to the EverCool option only, which is not fitted.

items.quote: allows samples to be cooled from room temperature to a stable 1.8 K in less than 30 minutes.
items.document_title: MPMS 3 Platform Measurement Options (Quantum Design brochure 1500-103 Rev. E1)
items.note: Sample cooldown from room temperature to the 1.8 K base in the (already cold, LHe-filled) standard dewar. Initial cooldown of the warm standard LHe dewar is not documented; the ~30 h / <50 h EverCool figures do not apply to this non-EverCool configuration.

items.location: page 1, OptiCool Specifications, Temperature Control: 'System Cooldown Time' row (PDF text extracts labels and values in separate columns; 17 hours is the third value, matching the third label)
items.note: Typical full-system cooldown of the OptiCool 7 T platform (+/-7 T spec sheet). Printed as typical, not a guaranteed maximum. Wiring options X300/X310 are not stated to change it.

items.location: page 1, OptiCool Specifications, Temperature Control: 'System Cooldown Time' row (labels and values extracted in separate columns)
items.note: Typical full-system cooldown of the OptiCool 7 T platform. Printed as typical, not a guaranteed maximum.

items.document_title: OptiCool Flex Optical Cryostat product announcement (Quantum Design, April 2026)
items.note: The Flex announcement only says the total thermal cycle time 'has decreased by over 30%' (relative, no absolute value) and gives no cooldown time; the 17 h (typical) figure is in the spec sheet of the magnet-equipped 7 T platform and is not stated for Flex. Not recorded.

No full-system room-temperature-to-base cooldown time is published for ProteoxLX (product page, LX brochure and Proteox Family brochure checked). The only time printed is the bottom-loader sample-puck cooldown (<6 h), and this configuration has no bottom loader (ISO100-2 Secondary Insert with wiring), so it does not apply.

No full-system room-temperature-to-base cooldown time is published for ProteoxMX (product page, MX brochure and Proteox Family brochure checked; the MX brochure says only that pucks cool to base 'in a matter of hours'). The <8 h figure is the bottom-loader puck cooldown, and this configuration has no bottom loader, so it does not apply.

items.quote: Our patented bottom loader and active gas gap heat switch technology enable fast sample turnaround times with sample puck cooldown times in less than 8 hours
items.document_title: Proteox MX - Modular Cryofree Dilution Refrigerator (product page)
items.note: Cooldown of a bottom-loaded sample puck (loaded warm, <15 min loading) to base in the cold ProteoxMX; this is the time to base for an experiment on this bottom-loader configuration. A full-system cooldown of the warm fridge with the 14 T magnet from room temperature is not documented.

items.document_title: RETSCH Mixer Mill MM 500 control - product page with Technical Data
items.note: RETSCH documents a user-set 'Setting of sample cooling time | digital, 0 ... 60 min (only with cryoPad)', which is an adjustable pre-cooling timer, not a documented pull-down time of the thermal plates/jars to the set point (down to -100 C). No pull-down time found in RETSCH documents.

items.document_title: CH-160D3LT 20K Cryocooler Series datasheet (SHI Cryogenics Group, 8/26)
items.note: SHI prints only 'Cooldown Time to 77 K <30 Minutes' (reference only), not the time to the 20 K operating point or the <17 K minimum. Cooldown to 77 K is not the operating/base temperature, so no value is recorded.

items.document_title: RDK-415D2 4K Cryocooler Series (SHI Cryogenics product page)
items.location: Specifications table, 'Cooldown Time to 4.2 K' row, footnote 1
items.note: Cold-head cooldown to the 4.2 K rating point; footnote 1: 'Lowest temperature and cooldown time are for reference only' (bare cold head, no customer load). One value for all compressor options and both supply frequencies.
